Sam: quick share — ran a cross-arch sweep on quantized kernels. H100 INT8 gives best cost/tok at seq<=512 & batch>=4, but at seq>1024 FP8 path is faster and more stable. profiling attached below.
Anya: nice. what's the perf delta numbers?
Sam: rough numbers (tokens/s):
```
A100 FP16 baseline: 320 tok/s @ seq=512,batch=4
A100 INT8 tuned: 520 tok/s
H100 FP8 tuned: 860 tok/s @ seq=512,batch=4
H100 INT8: 780 tok/s but drops to 410 tok/s @ seq=2048
x86 AVX512 INT8 (cpu): 40 tok/s
```
Devon: big drop on H100 INT8 at long seq — looks like KV cache path not using fused GEMM kernel for long sequences?
Sam: exactly. autotuner was picking the small-kernel INT8 GEMM with low memory footprint, but its tiling causes many KV cache copies beyond 1024 leading to corner-case thrash. we should add a sequence-length threshold in the policy.
Maya: proposal: policy rule order: (1) if arch==H100 and seq>1024 -> prefer FP8_fused_kv; (2) else if arch in {A100,H100} and batch>=4 and seq<=512 -> INT8_low_prec; (3) fallback to FP16.
Rik: agree. also add micro-bench flags for `kv_inplace_copy=false` to catch the copy overhead in CI.
Anya: can you paste the config snippet you tweaked?
Sam: sure:
```
kernel_picks:
  - name: h100_longseq_fp8
    arch: H100
    min_seq: 1025
    pick: FP8_FUSED_GEMM
  - name: ampere_int8_smallseq
    arch: A100,H100
    max_seq: 512
    min_batch: 4
    pick: INT8_TILED_GEMM
  - name: cpu_int8
    arch: x86
    pick: INT8_REFERENCE
fallback: FP16_DEFAULT
autotune:
  bench_iters: 30
  sample_seqs: [32,64,128,512,1024,2048]
  cost_metric: tokens_per_second
```
Devon: We should also surface a perf-regression alert when tokens/sec drops >20% after a kernel switch. InfraBot can we add that rule?
InfraBot: added alert `perf.kernel_switch_degradation` with threshold 20%.
Maya: good. Also adding per-arch tuning params: tile_size, simd_width, reorder_threshold. I'll PR.
Sam: gonna run another sweep with `kv_inplace_copy=false` and post results. Thanks :thumbsup:
